pivot_note: Viv's pivot (the spine at the back of the head); the same pivot as every girl sheet
lower_note: the boots are not in this sheet: draw Viv's exported lower frame given in each frame's `lower` under it (frames 0-1 = girl_walk_lower 0 / 4, the walk's contact steps; frame 2 = girl_stand_lower)
draw_order: draw order: the frame's lower, then this sheet frame i (torso, left arm, right arm, flashlight over the hand, cap). The whole sprite turns as one (MOVEMENT_PLAN 1)
state: flashlight raised, on (always: one carry state, as ranger_stand)
turn_note: he turns to face her: the game turns the whole sprite (240 deg/s, MOVEMENT_PLAN 3 / 6) while frames 0 then 1 play (the boot shuffle MOVEMENT_PLAN 2 gives standing turns). If the sprite is still turning after frame 1 (turns over ~62 deg), keep this sheet on frame 1 and only alternate the lower (girl_walk_lower 0, 4, 0, ... at 130 ms) until the rotation ends, so the arm never pulls back; then play frame 2 and hold it (the girl's caught plays meanwhile). Works for either direction, no flip
flashlight_note: his light is session 04's flashlight cone, from flashlight_tip along flashlight_angle_deg (deg out from straight ahead = down the sheet; + = toward screen-left, his right; - = in toward his centre line). Frame 2 aims 8 deg in: the beam crosses his centre line ~250 px (about 3 units) ahead, where she stands once he faces her; the game may aim the cone at her exact position from flashlight_tip instead
head_note: the cap is drawn in the sheet and turns with the light (head_turn_deg); head_center includes the walk's head_offset on frames 0-1
end_note: frame 2 is a held aim, not the stand: return to ranger_stand (a 4 px reach / 8 deg pop) only after the caught sequence resets the scene
sound_note: a soft footstep on each shuffle step (frames 0 and 1, and each repeated lower)
